game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Counter Tower: Increase a counter variable every time scrolls reach the royal vault, stacking the tower higher.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the royal vault using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
win_condition: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the royal vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Counter Tower' (Week 1 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how delivered changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 22.
